description: Pre-flight checks for Windows Server 2016 to 2022 in-place upgrade. This document only performs checks and never modifies the instance.

AutomationAssumeRole.description: (Optional) IAM role ARN the automation assumes - select WindowsUpgradeAutomationRole (created per iam-roles.md). If left empty, the run uses the invoking user's identity.

inputs.Script:
import boto3

def script_handler(events, context):
  instance_id = events['InstanceId']
  region = events['Region']
  ec2 = boto3.client('ec2', region_name=region)
  
  response = ec2.describe_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
  instance = response['Reservations'][0]['Instances'][0]
  instance_type = instance['InstanceType']
  
  warnings = []; notes = []
  
  # Check instance store
  instance_store_devices = [bdm['DeviceName'] for bdm in instance.get('BlockDeviceMappings', []) if 'Ebs' not in bdm]
  type_info = ec2.describe_instance_types(InstanceTypes=[instance_type])['InstanceTypes'][0]
  has_instance_store = type_info.get('InstanceStorageSupported', False)
  
  if instance_store_devices or has_instance_store:
    devices_str = ', '.join(instance_store_devices) if instance_store_devices else 'ephemeral storage available'
    notes.append(f'INFO: Instance store ({devices_str}) present - preserved across the upgrade (reboot only, no stop/start)')
  
  # Check public IP
  public_ip = instance.get('PublicIpAddress')
  if public_ip:
    eip_response = ec2.describe_addresses(Filters=[{'Name': 'public-ip', 'Values': [public_ip]}])
    if not eip_response['Addresses']:
      notes.append(f'INFO: Dynamic public IP ({public_ip}) is retained across the upgrade (reboot only; changes only on stop/start)')
  
  summary = [f'Instance ID: {instance_id}', f'Instance Type: {instance_type}', f'AZ: {instance["Placement"]["AvailabilityZone"]}']
  if public_ip:
    summary.append(f'Public IP: {public_ip}')
  summary.append('')
  summary.extend(notes); summary.extend(warnings if warnings else ['No warnings'])
  
  result = '\n'.join(summary)
  print(result)
  return {'Summary': result, 'HasWarnings': 'true' if warnings else 'false'}

commands: if ($os.Caption -notmatch 'Windows Server 2016') { throw 'ERROR: Not Windows Server 2016. Found: ' + $os.Caption }
if ($ssm.Status -ne 'Running') { throw 'ERROR: SSM Agent not running' }
if (Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending') { throw 'ERROR: Reboot pending' }
if ($ec2Config) { throw 'ERROR: EC2Config detected. Migrate to EC2Launch before upgrading.' }
# Report every non-AWS driver package and whether a present device uses it. Read-only: nothing is removed.
# Runs before the hypervisor check below so the CSVs are written even when that check stops the PreCheck.

$rows = @(Get-WindowsDriver -Online | Where-Object { $_.ProviderName -notmatch 'Amazon' } | ForEach-Object { $inf = $_.Driver.ToLower(); $st = if ($inUse -contains $inf) { 'in use' } elseif ($ghost -contains $inf) { 'removed device only' } else { 'no device' }; [pscustomobject]@{ Package = $_.Driver; Inf = (Split-Path $_.OriginalFileName -Leaf); Provider = $_.ProviderName; Class = $_.ClassName; Version = $_.Version; Date = $_.Date; State = $st; OtherHypervisor = ($hvNames -contains $inf) } })

foreach ($r in ($un | Select-Object -First 5)) { $tag = if ($r.OtherHypervisor) { ', other hypervisor' } else { '' }; Write-Output ('UNUSED: {0} = {1} ({2}, {3}, {4}{5})' -f $r.Package, $r.Inf, $r.Provider, $r.Class, $r.State, $tag) }

if ($unHv.Count -gt 0) { Write-Output ('WARN: ' + $unHv.Count + ' unused driver package(s) from other hypervisors (listed first above). Back up with Export-WindowsDriver -Online -Destination C:\DriverBackup, then remove each with pnputil -f -d <oemN.inf>.') }

if ($unOther -gt 0) { Write-Output ('INFO: ' + $unOther + ' other non-AWS driver package(s) not used by any present device. AWS Windows AMIs include AMD and Intel chipset drivers for other instance types; keep those. Review before removing anything: C:\Temp\upgrade-precheck-drivers.csv') }
if ($un.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output 'OK: All non-AWS driver packages are in use' }
} catch { Write-Output ('WARN: Driver usage report could not run: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }

if ($hvUsed.Count -gt 0) { Write-Output ('WARN: Driver(s) from another hypervisor bound to a present device: ' + (($hvUsed | ForEach-Object { $_.Driver + ' (' + (Split-Path $_.OriginalFileName -Leaf) + ', ' + $_.ProviderName + ')' }) -join ', ') + '. Review before upgrading.') } elseif ($hv.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output 'OK: No drivers from other hypervisors' }

$awsKeep = 0; foreach ($d in $aws) { $n = (Split-Path $d.OriginalFileName -Leaf).ToLower(); $v = $d.Version -as [version]; $newer = @($aws | Where-Object { (Split-Path $_.OriginalFileName -Leaf).ToLower() -eq $n -and ($_.Version -as [version]) -gt $v }); if ($inUse -contains $d.Driver.ToLower()) { Write-Output ('AWSDRIVER: {0} = {1} {2} (in use)' -f $d.Driver, $n, $d.Version) } elseif ($newer.Count -gt 0) { $sup += ($d.Driver + ' (' + $n + ' ' + $d.Version + ')') } else { $awsKeep++ } }

if ($sup.Count -gt 0) { Write-Output ('WARN: Older AWS driver versions still in the driver store: ' + ($sup -join ', ') + '. Optional cleanup: pnputil -f -d <oemN.inf>') } else { Write-Output 'OK: No superseded AWS driver versions' }
if ($awsKeep -gt 0) { Write-Output ('INFO: ' + $awsKeep + ' other AWS driver package(s) not bound to a device on this instance, kept for instance type changes') }
# Guest tools and agents from other hypervisors or clouds: services, kernel drivers and installed programs. Report only.

$toolPat = 'VMware Tools|VirtualBox Guest Additions|Parallels Tools|Citrix (XenServer|Hypervisor|VM) Tools|XenServer (VM Tools|Windows Management Agent)|XCP-ng|Xen PV Driver|Nutanix Guest|QEMU Guest Agent|SPICE|virtio-win|oVirt|RHEV|Red Hat VirtIO|Cloudbase-Init|Google Compute Engine|Azure VM Agent|WindowsAzure|Proxmox'

Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -match $svcPat -or $_.DisplayName -match $toolPat } | ForEach-Object { $found += [pscustomobject]@{ Type = 'service'; Name = $_.Name; Detail = $_.DisplayName + ' [' + $_.State + ', ' + $_.StartMode + ']' } }

Get-CimInstance Win32_SystemDriver | Where-Object { $_.Name -match $hvInf -or $_.DisplayName -match $hvProv } | ForEach-Object { $p = $_.PathName -replace '^\\SystemRoot', $env:SystemRoot -replace '^\\\?\?\\', ''; $co = ''; if ($p -and (Test-Path $p)) { $co = (Get-Item $p).VersionInfo.CompanyName }; if ($co -notmatch 'Amazon|Microsoft') { $found += [pscustomobject]@{ Type = 'kernel driver'; Name = $_.Name; Detail = $co + ' [' + $_.State + ']' } } }

Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*','HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -match $toolPat } | ForEach-Object { $found += [pscustomobject]@{ Type = 'program'; Name = $_.DisplayName; Detail = $_.Publisher + ' ' + $_.DisplayVersion } }
if ($found.Count -gt 0) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path C:\Temp -Force | Out-Null; $found | Export-Csv C:\Temp\upgrade-precheck-guest-tools.csv -NoTypeInformation

Write-Output ('WARN: ' + $found.Count + ' tool(s) from another hypervisor or cloud: ' + $names + '. They are not used on EC2 and can interfere with Setup. Uninstall before upgrading. Full list: C:\Temp\upgrade-precheck-guest-tools.csv') }
else { Write-Output 'OK: No tools from other hypervisors or clouds' }
} catch { Write-Output ('WARN: Guest tools scan could not run: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }
# Fail last, after every report above has run, so one PreCheck run shows everything to clean up.

if ($unused.Count -gt 0) { $msg = ('ERROR: ' + $unused.Count + ' unused driver package(s) from another hypervisor (see the UNUSED lines and C:\Temp\upgrade-precheck-drivers.csv). These can make Setup roll back with 0xC1900101. Take a backup, remove each with pnputil -f -d <oemN.inf>, then rerun PreCheck.'); Write-Output $msg; throw $msg }

inputs.Script:
def script_handler(events, context):
  print('=== PRE-CHECK COMPLETE ===')
  print('')
  print(events['Summary'])
  print('')
  print(f"Role: {events['RoleMessage']}")
  print('')
  print(events['OSChecks'])
  print('')
  os_lang = '1033'
  for line in events['OSChecks'].split('\n'):
    if line.startswith('OSLANGUAGE:'):
      os_lang = line.split(':')[1].strip()
  supported = ['1028','1029','1031','1033','1034','1036','1038','1040','1041','1042','1043','1045','1046','1049','1053','1055','2070','3082']
  if os_lang not in supported:
    raise Exception(f'INCOMPATIBLE: OS language LCID {os_lang} is not supported for in-place upgrade. Supported LCIDs: {supported}')
  print('All checks passed.')
  return {'Status': 'Complete', 'OSChecksRan': 'true', 'OSLanguage': os_lang}

def script_handler(events, context):
  print('=== PRE-CHECK COMPLETE (PARTIAL) ===')
  print('')
  print(events['Summary'])
  print('')
  print(f"Role: {events['RoleMessage']}")
  print('')
  print('NOTE: Unable to run OS checks - instance lacks SSM permissions.')
  print('OS checks include: Windows version, pending reboot, EC2Config, disk space/layout.')
  print('')
  print('API-based checks passed. Attach an SSM-enabled role to run full checks.')
  return {'Status': 'PartialComplete', 'OSChecksRan': 'false', 'OSLanguage': '1033'}
